show.name: India's Got Latent
show.overview: India's Got Latent is an Indian Hindi comedy talent show hosted by Samay Raina on YouTube. Inspired by the international Got Talent franchise and Kill Tony, it features a wide variety of acts including singing, dancing, magic, and comedy.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Samay Raina and the guest judges hilariously critique the untapped, undeniably entertaining "latent" talents of aspiring performers, testing their self-awareness with a unique scoring system.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Samay Raina returns for another season of his unconventional comedy competition, in which contestants predict their own scores before performing.
